name: Ensoras – AI Customer Support & Live Chat Helpdesk for WooCommerce
author: Ensoras AI

sections.description:
Ensoras is a complete AI customer support platform for WordPress and WooCommerce. Live chat, email, helpdesk ticketing, workflows, knowledge base, analytics, and team collaboration in one place. The AI resolves tickets on its own by looking up real store data, following your workflows, and closing conversations automatically.

Set it up in under 10 minutes. No training data, no coding. Start free with 30 tickets per month, no credit card required.

“1,100 tickets a month, resolved automatically. We don’t have support agents anymore.”
Head of Operations, mid-size fashion e-commerce (EU)

Why WooCommerce Stores Choose Ensoras

  • Resolves tickets, not just responds. The AI takes real action mid-conversation: order lookups, refund checks, tracking links, and closing tickets automatically
  • Under 2-minute response times, 24/7. Nights, weekends, Black Friday. Customers always get instant, accurate help
  • Converts browsers into buyers. Pre-sale questions about sizing, shipping, and returns answered in seconds while customers are ready to buy
  • Natural language workflows. Write rules in plain English: “auto-resolve refund requests under $100, escalate everything else to billing”
  • 25+ integrations. Stripe, Klaviyo, Zendesk, Shopify, BigCommerce, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and more

WooCommerce Customer Support

Connect WooCommerce in one click and the AI gets full access to your store data:

  • Look up customers, orders, products, and refunds in real time
  • Returning customers recognized automatically with no setup required
  • Pre-fill customer emails so there’s zero friction for returning buyers
  • Ensoras can look up data but never modify your store
  • WooCommerce tools and workflows are created automatically during setup

Live Chat Widget

A fully branded, embeddable live chat widget that installs in one click:

  • Dark or light theme, left or right position, custom logo and greeting
  • Mobile-responsive on every device and screen size
  • Display on all pages or control by page ID/slug
  • Custom agent name and personality so customers see your brand, not ours
  • Email collection before chat starts for order lookup and follow-up
  • Domain restrictions and privacy notice support

Email Customer Support

Connect your support inbox and the AI handles email alongside live chat:

  • Incoming emails auto-create tickets with AI-drafted responses
  • Smart thread tracking so replies match existing conversations automatically
  • Inbox rules to filter spam and macros for templated responses
  • Configurable response delays so emails feel natural
  • Same AI, same workflows, same intelligence across both channels

Helpdesk Ticketing & Unified Inbox

Everything in one place. No switching between tools:

  • Chat and email merged per customer with full history across channels
  • 5-tier priority from Low to Critical, set manually or via workflows
  • Bulk actions, scheduled messages, and draft review before sending
  • Advanced filtering by channel, status, priority, team, agent, tags, or date
  • Active chats view with live presence indicators showing who is on your site right now

Workflows & Automation

This is what separates Ensoras from every chatbot on the market. Workflows are intelligent reasoning, not “if keyword then template” rules:

  • Write instructions in plain English: “When a customer asks about a refund, look up their order. If under $100 and within 30 days, process it. Otherwise, escalate to billing.”
  • AI analysis, keyword matching, exact phrase, and regex triggers
  • Multiple workflows merge automatically so the AI combines tools and instructions from all matching workflows
  • 8 action types: send emails, Slack alerts, webhooks, change status, add tags, assign agents, update priority, and more
  • Full execution visibility with every triggered workflow and action logged in the ticket

Knowledge Base

Upload your docs and the AI answers from them accurately:

  • Add text, upload files (PDF, TXT, Markdown), or paste a URL for automatic scraping
  • Semantic matching finds answers by meaning, not keywords
  • Toggle items on/off without deleting. Re-scrape URLs with one click when content changes

Dashboard & Analytics

Your support command center with live updates:

  • Ticket statistics with trend sparklines and volume alerts
  • Automation rate showing AI-resolved vs. escalated tickets
  • Customer satisfaction scores with sentiment breakdown
  • Response time, resolution time, and escalation rate metrics
  • Per-workflow success rates, trigger counts, and top tools

Team Collaboration

Built for teams, not just solo founders:

  • Custom roles with granular permissions across 15 permission groups
  • Team routing to send tickets to the right team via workflows
  • Collision detection so two agents never reply to the same ticket
  • Invite team members by email in seconds

Two Modes for Every Comfort Level

  • Manual mode. AI drafts every reply for your approval before sending. Edit, regenerate with different instructions, or send as-is
  • Auto mode. Fully autonomous with guardrails you define in plain English. The AI escalates when it’s not confident

Built-in Guardrails

  • Security guidelines the AI cannot override: “Never share account details without verification”
  • Reply approval mode to hold all AI responses as drafts for human review
  • Escalation timeout so the AI re-engages or notifies the team if a human doesn’t respond
  • Auto-closure for inactive tickets with optional notification
  • Full audit trail with every tool call, action, and AI decision logged

Pricing

  • Free. $0/month, 30 tickets, full AI, no credit card
  • Starter. €39/month, 100 tickets
  • Pro. €89/month, 400 tickets
  • Enterprise. €399/month, 2,000 tickets

External Services

This plugin relies on the Ensoras external service to provide AI-powered customer support functionality. All AI processing, ticket management, and workflow execution happen on the Ensoras platform.

Account registration

When creating an account through the plugin, your email address, name, and site URL are sent to Ensoras to create your support project.

Chat widget

The chat widget is loaded from Ensoras (app.ensoras.com) on every page where the widget is displayed. Chat messages entered by visitors are sent to Ensoras for AI processing and ticket creation.

Email verification

During account setup, your email address and name are sent to Ensoras to send a verification code.

WooCommerce provisioning (optional)

If you connect WooCommerce, read-only API credentials and your store URL are sent to Ensoras so it can access order and product data on behalf of your support team.

Customer identification (optional)

When enabled, logged-in WooCommerce customer emails are passed to the widget so Ensoras can identify returning customers and look up their order history.

Usage analytics (optional)

When enabled in settings, basic environment information (PHP, WordPress, and WooCommerce versions, active features) is shared with Ensoras once daily to help improve the product. No customer data, order details, or personal information is collected. You can opt out at any time in the plugin settings.

Service links

  • Ensoras Terms of Service
  • Ensoras Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install through the WordPress plugin screen (search “Ensoras”) or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Ensoras menu in your WordPress admin.
  4. Create a free Ensoras account (takes 30 seconds) or enter your existing project slug and API key.
  5. (Optional) If WooCommerce is active, click “Connect WooCommerce” to enable order and product lookup.

Your AI helpdesk is live. Start resolving tickets immediately.
sections.faq:
Is there a free AI chatbot plugin for WordPress?

Yes. Ensoras includes a free plan with 30 AI-powered tickets per month, full AI capabilities, and e-commerce integrations. No credit card required. The free plan is free forever.

How do I add an AI chatbot to WordPress?

Install the Ensoras plugin, create a free account, add your docs to the knowledge base, and your AI helpdesk is live in under 10 minutes. No training data, no code.

Does this AI chatbot work without WooCommerce?

Yes. The chat widget, email channel, and full AI helpdesk work on any WordPress site. WooCommerce integration is optional and adds order lookup, customer identification, and automatic identity verification.

Can an AI chatbot actually resolve support tickets?

Yes. Ensoras looks up real order data, checks refund eligibility, shares tracking links, escalates to the right team, and closes resolved conversations. All automatically, mid-conversation.

What WooCommerce data can the AI access?

Ensoras can look up customers, orders, products, and refunds but cannot modify any data in your store. Logged-in customers are recognized automatically for a seamless experience.

Can I review AI responses before they’re sent?

Yes. Enable “Require Reply Approval” and every AI response is held as a draft. Edit, regenerate, or approve. Most users start in approval mode and switch to auto after the first week.
